summary: This bill formally authorizes the Organized Crime Drug Enforcement Task Forces (OCDETF) to combat transnational organized crime and reduce illicit narcotics in the U.S. through a prosecutor-led, multi-agency approach, and requires a report on its successes, with the authorization expiring in 2029.

scores.thoughts: This bill is primarily focused on authorizing and structuring the Organized Crime Drug Enforcement Task Forces (OCDETF) to combat transnational organized crime and reduce the availability of illicit narcotics. This directly relates to stricter drug enforcement by strengthening existing mechanisms.

The bill aims to enhance law enforcement efforts against organized crime and drug trafficking through a multi-agency, prosecutor-led approach. This directly supports stricter justice and stronger policing by reinforcing and formalizing these task forces.
